title: Lisbon's wind warning on Wednesday: IPMA's message says orange, its open-data feed still said red
event_source: IPMA's CAP message PO-01-1932, as row s-1111T0738 gives it (not checked here)
summary: IPMA sent a CAP message at 07:16:30 on Wednesday lowering Lisbon's wind warning from red (12:00 to 21:00) to orange, 09:00 to 21:00, gusts up to 120 km/h (fact, row s-1111T0738; the whole change, eleven messages, row s-1111T0824). At the 08:00 read, more than an hour later, IPMA's own open-data feed still listed the wind as red, 12:00 to 21:00 (fact as read, row s-1111T0822). Both are IPMA's channels. On Tuesday night the feed followed a CAP message about two and a half hours later (row s-1110T2353). The red rain warning, 09:00 to 18:00, is the same in both.
closes: A read of IPMA's open-data feed that lists Lisbon's wind as orange, 09:00 to 21:00 (the two channels agree), with the time read; or a statement by IPMA on which channel stands.

sides.held_by: IPMA's open-data feed as read at 08:00 (fact as read)

history.change: card opened from rows s-1111T0738, s-1111T0822 and s-1111T0824: IPMA's two channels disagree on Lisbon's wind warning; watching because the weather agents re-read the feed at each wake
